name: KIC 3121983
description: A red giant climbing its first giant branch in the Kepler field, 22.5 solar radii and 1.09 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 3121983 (Gold): Radius (Mosser scale, solar radii) 22.5011 +/- 0.4031

mass.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 3121983 (Gold): Mass (Mosser scale, solar masses) 1.0888 +/- 0.0434

temperature.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 3121983 (Gold): APOGEE effective temperature (K) 4214.313 +/- 41.6227

gravity.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 3121983 (Gold): Asteroseismic log g 1.7495 +/- 0.004

color.reason: The star lies in the Galactic plane hundreds to thousands of parsecs away, where interstellar dust reddens its spectra, and the color routes do not remove it; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant in the Kepler field, 23 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations give 1.09 solar masses and 22.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,214 K at its surface.
